subject: Geopolitics
title: The Five Eyes Intelligence Alliance
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Five Eyes Intelligence Alliance.

hook.text: Five nations share every secret: the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. No other club is this tight.

buildup.text: Five Eyes began as a World War II signals intelligence pact. It evolved into the world's most powerful spy network.

discovery.text: Each nation monitors a region. Together they cover the globe. Raw intelligence is shared in near real time.

twist.text: Snowden revealed Five Eyes also spied on allied leaders and ordinary citizens. Trust inside the club cracked briefly.

climax.text: Despite scandals, Five Eyes endures. In a world of shifting alliances, this old spy club remains rock solid.

punchline.text: The alliance you never see is the one that matters most.
